thread:
olivia: Heads up — customers in Dedicated region eu-west-1 reporting elevated 5xxs on inference since 00:12 UTC.
jana: Confirmed. sw-prod-1 returning 503s. Error spike correlated with recent model rollout 1.14.3-quant at 00:05 UTC.
mike: Any quick triage notes? impact scope? SLA hit?
jana: ~12% traffic failing for a handful of high-throughput tenants. Latency also increased. Looks like 1.14.3-quant increases GPU memory pressure and OOMs on longer sequences.
sre_lead: We should pin back to 1.14.2 immediately for affected hosts and do a targeted canary. Need expedited approval for override of the change window.
olivia: I approve emergency pin/rollback for eu-west-1 only. Notifying support + sales.
eng_manager: +1 from me. Keep it regional, don't cascade to other regions yet. Post deploy, we need a short rollback blameless postmortem.
jana: Plan:
```
# pin nodes in eu-west-1 to model 1.14.2-hotfix
deploy-bot patch-model --cluster sw-prod-1 --model-id redwood/ggml-1.14.2-hotfix
# start 3-node canary
deploy-bot rollout --cluster sw-prod-1 --subset canary --wait 5m
```
mike: Add a gateway fallback rule if canary fails: route to hosted variant in the same region.
jana: noted. I'll attach release note snippet and commands in the rollout.
deploy-bot: [CI] running model pin job 8934. Required approvals: 2. Waiting for approvers: olivia, sre_lead.
olivia: :thumbsup: approving emergency model-pin job 8934.
sre_lead: :thumbsup: approve. tagging incident for follow-up.
deploy-bot: [CI] approvals received. Starting rollout job 8934 -> job 8934.1
deploy-bot: [rollout] canary nodes (3) updated to redwood/ggml-1.14.2-hotfix. Health checks: in progress.
jana: canary logs look good so far, 0 5xx in last 2m, latency back to baseline.
mike: start gradual roll to remaining eu-west-1 pool if stable at 5m.
deploy-bot: [rollout] canary healthy at 5m. Continuing to remaining nodes. Estimated completion 00:50 UTC.
oncall_bot: Alert suppression active for this incident window. Pager duty notify disabled for subsequent repeating alerts.
eng_manager: QA, please smoke test inference paths for top 5 tenants and confirm.
olivia: Support notified customers with temporary mitigation steps and ETA for full rollback.
deploy-bot: [rollout] completed at 00:48 UTC. All eu-west-1 nodes pinned to 1.14.2-hotfix. 5xx count down to normal.
jana: Monitoring for 30m post-rollout. If we see regression, we'll flip traffic to hosted variant and open rollback.
sre_lead: Documenting change window: emergency rollback 00:20-00:50 UTC. Release note draft:
- emergency pin to 1.14.2-hotfix in eu-west-1 to mitigate elevated 5xx after 1.14.3-quant rollout
- impact: brief degraded requests for some Dedicated customers
- follow-up: postmortem in #postmortems and model regression tests to be extended
mike: Thanks team. After 30m, if stable, we can close the incident and schedule a controlled re-eval of 1.14.3-quant with additional memory tests.
eng_manager: Closing message: Great coordination. Please add links to logs and the canary run in the incident doc.
jana: will add logs + perf traces. Monitoring window started.
deploy-bot: [incident] incident 2026-03-20-ev1 closed (provisional).
